title: The Case of the Pie Server
story: Sixty years of church suppers, and Hattie's grandmother's silver pie server had never gone astray. Then came the early-November pie auction, where the town orders its Thanksgiving pies, and somewhere between bids it vanished. Five helpers each baked one pie, arrived at a different time and worked a different spot. The server turned up that night in a coat in the cloakroom, and only the cloakroom helper had handled the coats. Who slipped the pie server into a coat pocket?

question.text: Who slipped the pie server into a coat pocket?

texts: The stage helper arrived exactly 45 minutes after the mince pie's baker.
The pecan pie's baker is neither Della nor Vito.
Of the pecan pie's baker and the bake table helper, one is Rosa and the other is Della.
The mince pie's baker worked either the kitchen or the bake table.
The pumpkin pie's baker arrived 15 minutes after the stage helper.
Of the pumpkin pie's baker and the porch helper, one is Gus and the other is Imani.
The porch helper arrived later than the bake table helper.
Of the apple pie's baker and the mince pie's baker, one is Vito and the other is Imani.

trace.text: Clue 2 gives an X.

Clue 1 means the stage cannot be 6:00 p.m., 6:15 p.m., or 6:30 p.m. and the mince pie cannot be 6:30 p.m., 6:45 p.m., or 7:00 p.m.
Since the stage can still be only 6:45 p.m. or 7:00 p.m., clue 5 means the pumpkin pie cannot be 6:00 p.m., 6:15 p.m., 6:30 p.m., or 6:45 p.m. and the stage cannot be 7:00 p.m.
